source:
**ORKS INFANTRY** model only (excluding **WEIRDBOY** models). This model’s ranged attacks have:
- **[ANTI-INFANTRY 4+}**

- **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]**.

reason: BSData (and so New Recruit) has a typo (a brace and no full stop after [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+]); the app has the enhancement's wording as the rules publish it.
evidence: Wahapedia, Orks, Shoota Boyz detachment, enhancement Supa-glowy Fing: "This model’s ranged attacks have: - [Anti-Infantry 4+]. - [Devastating Wounds]. - [SUPA-HAZARDOUS]." (verify/.cache/waha/orks.html); verify/texts.js checks the app's text against it. NR prints the typo (verify/sources/nr/shooty.txt).

reason: New Recruit prints this stat row without a model count ("Flash Gitz - Flash Gitz": the Kaptin and the 9 Flash Gitz share it); the app shows the row as New Recruit prints it, and its models lines give 1× Kaptin and 9× Flash Gitz.
evidence: verify/sources/nr/shooty.txt line 161: "Flash Gitz - Flash Gitz  6"  5  4+  3  7+  1  40mm"; lines 157-158: "1x Kaptin", "9x Flash Gitz".
